en.html:
He examined what I had given him in apparent wonder, then pressed its head down.
Gas spurted from the opening and struck him directly in the face.
en.text:
He examined what I had given him in apparent wonder, then pressed its head down.
Gas spurted from the opening and struck him directly in the face.

ja.html:
俺が渡したものを彼は不思議そうに見詰め、やがて
頭を押し込んだ。
　口からガスが噴き出し、彼の顔面を直撃する。
ja.text:
俺が渡したものを彼は不思議そうに見詰め、やがて
頭を押し込んだ。
　口からガスが噴き出し、彼の顔面を直撃する。

en.html: ...Was that the right thing to have done?
en.text: ...Was that the right thing to have done?

ja.html: ……これで良かったのだろうか？
ja.text: ……これで良かったのだろうか？
